at.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the row was computed

repo.description: owner/repo the keys were computed for

deploys.description: PRs merged to main in the window (deployment frequency)

lead_time_h.description: median hours from first commit to merge

restore_h.description: median hours from a revert's target merge to the revert merge

reverts.description: merged PRs whose title matches the revert pattern

held_7d.description: merged PRs older than 7 days with no revert against them

description: DORA four keys per repo per run (crew#495) plus task-outcome fields (crew#368): reverts = merged PRs whose title reverts a prior one, held_7d = merged PRs still open on main after 7 days with no revert.
